value.rationale: The identity is uniform over every finite symmetric rank-three action and every subset of the point set. It reduces a genuinely nonabelian trace-norm problem to two combinatorial statistics and connects quantitative idempotent norms with induced-subgraph data of strongly regular orbital graphs. This is a reusable structural lemma rather than a one-off computation or arbitrary finite slice.
